summary: Master climate adaptation finance and proposal development with practical tools for concept notes, budgets, and fundable adaptation proposals.
lede: Climate adaptation finance and proposal development help climate project professionals turn risk evidence into structured funding proposals. The course is for finance officers, proposal writers, programme managers and other practitioners preparing adaptation bids or results reports, and covers climate rationale, theory of change and logframe design. Learners also practise budget narratives, safeguards planning and donor-aligned reporting to prepare and review proposal materials.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already contribute to climate project design, funding bids, or results reporting and need stronger proposal development capability.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a current project idea or proposal draft, and any available climate risk, baseline, or budget material you can use in exercises. Participants should have basic familiarity with donor-funded project cycles and be ready to work with templates, structured drafting tools, and review checklists.
